title: Mechanistic insights into paracetamol adsorption from water using ZnO nanoparticle-immobilized chitosan-inulin composites: Fractal kinetics, statistical physics, thermodynamic analysis, and application to real water samples
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00116A, Paper
